newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.870 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.870 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended December 7 was 4,870,788 gallons compared with 3,612,640 gallons last week.
Imports were 804,225 gallons compared with 536,135 gallons the previous week.There were no domestic receipts this week or the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,186,233 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,176,094 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 10,218,085 gallons.
